Hi Liam — thanks for the W-9 and the quick follow-up. 

To expedite vendor master creation, procurement typically needs: legal entity name, tax ID (you included EIN, good), registered address, remit address, AP contact (name + email + phone), preferred payment method (ACH/wire/check), and a signed vendor onboarding form. For Redwood's compliance we will also need a beneficial ownership declaration if the entity is privately held (>25% ownership disclosure).

I've attached our standard onboarding form (PDF) and a short checklist — please complete the form and sign the beneficial ownership declaration where applicable. If you prefer DocuSign we can generate a packet; I'll include a DocuSign link once we confirm the AP contact.

Marissa from AP is copied — Marissa, could you confirm required bank fields for ACH and whether our default payment terms are net-30? Also looping Karthik in case procurement needs to negotiate PO terms.

Next steps suggested:
- Liam: complete attached onboarding form and return with signed beneficial ownership declaration (if required) + AP contact details.
- Marissa: confirm Redwood payment-term flexibility and the ACH field template.

Thanks,
Sofia
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf; Onboarding_Checklist.txt
